newsitem.title: USA: McWhorter buys Italian-based resin maker.
newsitem.headline: McWhorter buys Italian-based resin maker.

text.p: McWhorter Technologies Inc said Friday it completed the acquisition of Syntech SpA, a privately owned Italian-based liquid and powder resins company with 1996 sales of approximately $85 million.

"The addition of Syntech gives McWhorter an expanded presence in Europe, Asia and North America," John Stevenson, McWhorter chairman, said in a statement. "Syntech's growing European and North American powder resins business will be combined with McWhorter's current powder resins and curatives to create a significant global powder coatings supplier."
He said the acquisition makes McWhorter "well positioned" in North America and Europe to serve multinational coatings companies.
Giulio Napoli, Syntech's managing director, will join McWhorter to lead the company's newly acquired business in Europe.
Syntech has two production facilities in Italy producing a broad range of resin products. The company also has subsidiaries in the United States and France and joint ventures in Italy and Hong Kong.
The venture in Hong Kong is currently building a manufacturing facility in China to produce coating resins with a start-up date of early 1998.
McWhorter makes resins used in the paint and coatings and resins used in the reinforced fiberglass plastics industry.
